import sys
MOD = 998244353

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.strip())
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
    inv_fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv_fact[n] = pow(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD
    result = 0
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        result += fact[n] * inv_fact[k] * inv_fact[n - k + 1] % MOD
        result %= MOD
    print(result)

main()
